items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: He was with us all along around that time... He was with you in what band? Tuxedo. Orchestra or brass band? No, in both.

ctx.x: and made a new piece out of the melody line. Yeah. And made clarendina everybody,

and he called it high society. High society. And that's how he could play. I see. Him, George Bacchier, and a fellow called Tio, them as the men who played at the same. Which Tio? Which one, though? Oh, yeah, now the clarinet player, Lorenzo Tio. See, all of the Tios, all those old men, you know, they've been there, they're professional clarinet players. Them old men, they've been there, but Tio was the... The younger one. The guy used to be with Tio in the 20s? Yeah, he used to play with me. He was with us all…
He was with you in what band? Tuxedo. Orchestra or brass band? No, in both.
